component.name: Now Playing
component.summary: Live activities in the panel: what's playing, apps recording, and the charger plugged in
Atividades ao vivo no painel: o que está tocando, apps gravando e o carregador ligado

description.p: Live activities in the COSMIC™ panel, like the iPhone's Now Playing. Click it to open a Now Playing card like the one in the macOS menu bar, drawn in your COSMIC theme.

ul.li: What's playing in any MPRIS player, with its cover, and bars dancing in the theme's accent color
The Now Playing card: a large cover, the title and artist, previous, play/pause and next, and a progress bar you can drag, with the time gone and the time left
Apps recording from the microphone, with a red dot and how long they have been recording
The charger plugged in, shown for a moment
Middle-click the applet to play or pause
